## 中文原文
晚上你在家整理宝宝的衣物，挑出几件变小穿不下的干净衣服，打算打包送给朋友家同样有小宝宝的邻居。整理的时候你翻到了宝宝刚出生时穿的小连体衣，看着觉得很感慨。

## My translation
I was sorting out my baby's clothes this evening and picked out several clean too-small-to-fit ones.
I planned to package and give them away to my neighbors who also had a small baby.
During the sorting, I found the onesie worn by my baby when he was born.
I was surprised how time flew by.

## Revised version
I was going through my baby's clothes this evening and set aside a few clean pieces that no longer fit him.
I planned to pack them up and pass them along to a neighbor who also has a little baby.
As I sorted through everything, I found the onesie he wore right after he was born.
I was surprised at how fast time flies.

## Key phrases
- going through the clothes，有整理的意思
- set aside
- pack them up
- pass them along
- little baby
- sorted through everything
